GENERATED by tools/extract-rmxp-warps.rb — internal (non-edge) warps for
the RMXP Kanto/Johto maps. Edge links live in rmxp-connections.json.

Shape of every entry in `warps` and `manual`:
  from    our map slug the player is standing on
  x, y    the trigger TILE on that map (not pixels)
  trigger "touch" -> onPlayerTouch, "action" -> onAction (talk/confirm)
  to      destination map slug
  tx, ty  arrival TILE; snapFree() moves it off any blocked cell
  dir     RMXP facing on arrival: 0 keep, 2 down, 4 left, 6 right, 8 up

`warps` is regenerated from the .rxdata on every run. `manual` is
hand-authored and PRESERVED across runs — put links there when the source
project has no events to extract.
_manual_note:
`warps` is empty and that is not a bug: the Remastered Kanto Johto Map Pack
ships NO events at all (every Map###.rxdata unmarshals with @events == {}),
so there are no code-201 Transfer Player commands to extract. It is an art
pack for mappers, not a playable project. See docs/rmxp-map-import.md.

The links below are therefore HAND-AUTHORED, not extracted. Each one was
found by rendering the .tmx at full resolution, reading the cave mouth /
ladder off the art, and confirming the tile is walkable in the map's
<id>.hitboxes.json. Both directions of every link are listed explicitly.
Destination pairings follow Gold/Silver geography (Ice Path joins Route 44
to Blackthorn City; Dark Cave joins Route 31 to Route 46) — the pack itself
records no destinations, so the pairing is a judgement call, not data.

THE BRIDGE BETWEEN THE TWO WORLDS. The PSDK island and the Kanto/Johto region shared no warp at all, so the whole region was unreachable in a real session and — now that fast travel requires having walked somewhere — permanently locked. Exchange City's dock ship sails to Olivine, a port city, which is the one pairing that reads as a ferry rather than a teleport. Action trigger, not touch: the spawn tile is here, and a touch warp would fire the moment a player loads in.
